# Greetings
Hello every! My name is Adler Torres and during this August semester of 2026, I find myself taking the R courses as part of the course work for my Master in Biology. In this webpage you will find a brief overview of my journey up-until-now of obtaining this academic grade, and the various R tutorials required as part of the R course.

## Academic Interest
My academic interest mainly lays in learning how the natural world works and how to properly protect it. More specifically, I am working towards becoming a licensed Ethologist, an ecologist that focuses on studying animal behavior, with a specialization in arachnids. Why? Because they're cool honestly, and I have always thought that the behavior of these miniscule invertebrates has always been an under-explored part of science.
